cover_dek: Wholesale prices climbed in October at their highest annual rate in four years.
big_headline: Wholesale prices in the US rose 0.3% in October, reaching a 6.5% annual rate.
big_body: Wholesale producer prices rose 0.3% in October. The annual rate is the highest in nearly four years. Dow Jones expected a 0.4% increase.
pol_body: Bitcoin fell to $68,000. A total of $798 million in crypto positions was liquidated over four hours, including $718.5 million in long positions.
biz_body: Germany plans to buy a one-third stake in Urenco, a uranium enrichment firm, for up to €4 billion. Britain asked for it.
up_body: Stelco will recall 175 laid-off workers in Hamilton on Dec. 1 with retroactive pay. The company will restart plant finishing lines.
